taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-12, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1228.3 | 0.41 | 0.41
2 | 678.3 | 0.50 | 0.91
3 | 2104.5 | 0.76 | 1.67
4 | 3417.4 | 29.87 | 31.54
5 | 3516.3 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we analyze the resistivity values of the five layers in groups of three consecutive layers:

1.  **Layers 1, 2, 3:** Resistivities are 1228.3, 678.3, and 2104.5.
    Since $1228.3 > 678.3 < 2104.5$ ($r_1 > r_2 < r_3$), the letter is **H**.

2.  **Layers 2, 3, 4:** Resistivities are 678.3, 2104.5, and 3417.4.
    Since $678.3 < 2104.5 < 3417.4$ ($r_2 < r_3 < r_4$), the letter is **A**.

3.  **Layers 3, 4, 5:** Resistivities are 2104.5, 3417.4, and 3516.3.
    Since $2104.5 < 3417.4 < 3516.3$ ($r_3 < r_4 < r_5$), the letter is **A**.

Combining these results in order gives the curve type HAA.

{"curve_type": "HAA"}
